name: Always Vigilant
blurb: Defend Rover while he repairs the communications uplink!

stages.log_text: One of Abbie's pre-recorded alerts went off, notifying me that the communications uplink repair robot known as Rover has been damaged. I need to find and repair him at the Relay Tower.
I found and repaired Rover at the Relay Tower. I need to stay and protect him while he finishes his work repairing the communications uplink for the Scorched Detection System.
Rover finally finished repairing the communications uplink for the Scorched Detection System. Now, I need to reboot the terminal inside the Relay Tower to bring it back online.
